El seguro de hogar e impago cuesta 228 € al año. ¿Qué rentabilidad neta anual obtengo, antes de impuestos? Expresa la respuesta como porcentaje con dos decimales.

So, the effective rental income would be 480 € multiplied by 11.5 months (since 12 - 0.5 = 11.5). Let me check that: 480 * 11.5 = 5520 € per year.

Next, the Gastos. The user listed several expenses: IBI is 1.105 € per year, comunidad is 29 € per month, which is 29 * 12 = 348 € per year. Then there's maintenance, which is 5% of the income. The income is 5520 €, so 5% of that is 276 €. The gestora (management fee) is 6% of the income, so 6% of 5520 is 331.2 €. The seguro is 228 € per year. 

Adding all these expenses: IBI (1.105) + comunidad (348) + maintenance (276) + gestora (331.2) + seguro (228). Let me sum them up: 1.105 + 348 = 349.105; plus 276 is 625.105; plus 331.2 is 956.305; plus 228 is 1184.305 € total expenses.

Now, the Renta cobrada is 5520 €, so the net income is 5520 - 1184.305 = 4335.695 €. 

The investment total is 73,000 €. So the net return is (4335.695 / 73000) * 100. Let me calculate that. 4335.695 divided by 73000 equals approximately 0.0592, which is 5.92% when rounded to two decimal places. 

Wait, but I need to make sure I didn't miss any other expenses. The user mentioned "mantenimiento" as 5% of the income, which I included. The gestora is 6% of the income, which I also included. The seguro is 228 €, which is correct. The IBI and comunidad are annual, so that's correct. The 0.5 months without tenant is accounted for in the 11.5 months. 

So the final answer should be 5.92%.
</think>

<answer>5.92</answer>
